FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale on every fallback lookup, including before the database is available (db:migrate on fresh DB, assets:precompile, boot-time initializers), introducing a DB dependency that can raise during bootstrap/deploy

records.issue_text: The '# order: after 02-freedom_patches.rb' comment is informational only; initializer ordering relies on alphabetical filename coincidence, and renaming the file could cause the I18n.backend.class include to run before the accelerator patch; an explicit require_dependency or numbered filename is needed
records.rationale: The new initializer `config/initializers/i18n.rb` contains only a comment `# order: after 02-freedom_patches.rb` but no mechanism to enforce load order. Rails initializers run by filename order, so today `02-freedom_patches.rb` would likely run before `i18n.rb`, but the diff shows no explicit dependency to guarantee that `I18n.backend.class.send(:include, I18n::Backend::Fallbacks)` runs after what
